purpose: Portable project-semantics conformance corpus (PA5): executable evidence that the Nift CLI and the C++ project-aware Engine observe the same Nift project semantics, runnable against any implementation. Each case under cases/ is a fixture project + expected.json; run_conformance.py executes every case against the CLI and the Engine. nift-rs inherits this corpus later.

categories.parity: byte-identical CLI build output == Engine.render(page) output for the listed pages, plus matching dependency/requirement sets when the case sets deps_reqs:true.
categories.reject: both implementations reject the same invalid project or source state (CLI build fails; Engine render fails): accept/reject parity.
categories.engine-only: embedding contracts with no artificial CLI equivalent: Context value/title overlays, injected environment provider, unknown page, is_open()/open_error(). Executable evidence: tests/engine_project.cpp.
categories.lifecycle: C++ Engine serving contracts: atomic metadata-generation replacement via reload(), last-good retention on failed reload, zero-write serving. These are implementation contracts, NOT template-language semantics; nift-rs only inherits them if project-aware Rust adopts the same serving API. Executable evidence: tests/engine_reload.cpp.

cases.comprehensive: tracked-name lookup; index/trailing-slash geometry; content/template composition; metadata (title/name/content-path/output-path); @input; @json; contracts; tracked @pathto; concrete @pathto; 404 root-absolute geometry; pagination primary page; dependencies; requirements.
cases.schema: JSON schema validation and schema dependency recording.
cases.getenv: @getenv default process-environment semantics (driver sets the variable for both implementations).
cases.missing-source: tracked page whose content source is missing: both reject.
cases.path-escape: @pathto escaping the project root: both reject.
